title: Lead Information Security Engineer
description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Information Security Engineer

 **In this role, you will:**

* Lead computer security incident response activities for highly complex events
* Conduct technical investigation of security related incidents and post incident digital forensics to identify causes and recommend future mitigation strategies
* Provide security consulting on large projects for internal clients to ensure conformity with corporate information, security policy, and standards
* Design, document, test, maintain, and provide issue resolution recommendations for highly complex security solutions related to networking, cryptography, cloud, authentication and directory services, email, internet, applications, and endpoint security
* Review and correlate security logs
* Utilize subject matter knowledge in industry leading security solutions and best practices to implement one or more components of information security such as availability, integrity, confidentiality, risk management, threat identification, modeling, monitoring, incident response, access management, and business continuity
* Identify security vulnerabilities and issues, perform risk assessments, and evaluate remediation alternatives
* Collaborate and influence all levels of professionals including managers
* Lead a team to achieve objectives

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of Information Security Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

 **Desired Qualifications:**

* Knowledge of test automation and performance testing tools.
* Understanding of workload modeling, baseline, stress, and endurance testing.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to collaborate with Application Owners, Technical Managers, and engineering teams.
* Knowledge of CI/CD and automated testing practices.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

 **Job Expectations:**

* Support application teams with NGDC migration readiness and validation activities.
* Develop and execute automated and performance testing plans.
* Perform baseline, workload, stress, and endurance testing.
* Identify and troubleshoot performance, capacity, and reliability issues.
* Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and platform teams to drive successful migrations.
* Provide testing results, risk assessments, and migration readiness recommendations.
* Ensure applications meet quality, reliability, and operational requirements before migration.

**Posting End Date:**


22 Sep 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**


Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.


Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.


Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

title: Cybersecurity Engineer - OT
description:
### **What you will do**


* Support daily operations of OT security technologies, with a primary focus on OT asset visibility and detection platform, maintenance, and data quality


**What you will bring:**


* 3 to 5 years of experience in Cybersecurity Engineering and Operations

### **Job Summary**



The Junior OT Security Engineer supports the Operational Technology (OT) Security program by assisting in the management, monitoring, and continuous improvement of security technologies that protect manufacturing and industrial environments.



This role is focused on foundational OT cybersecurity operations, execution of Run \& Maintain (R\&M) activities, and maintaining strong asset visibility across OT environments. The engineer will work under the guidance of senior OT engineers to execute operational tasks, improve data quality, and help sustain OT security controls at scale.



This position plays a critical role in maintaining the health, accuracy, and reliability of OT security platforms and metrics, ensuring the program continues to mature and operate effectively.


### **Responsibilities**


* Support daily operations of OT security technologies, with a primary focus on OT asset visibility and detection platform, maintenance, and data quality
* Execute Run \& Maintain (R\&M) activities, including device classification, asset reconciliation, exception handling, and rule tuning
* Assist with maintaining high\-quality OT asset inventory
* Perform basic troubleshooting for discovery configurations, integrations, and platform health issues, escalating as needed
* Monitor OT security alerts, identify anomalies, and support investigation and escalation processes
* Support ongoing improvement of OT metrics (e.g., asset designation, collector health, visibility gaps) through continuous data cleanup and validation
* Assist with onboarding new sites, validating OT asset inventory, and supporting enforcement or audit readiness activities
* Contribute to development and improvement of standard work procedures, documentation, and operational playbooks
* Partner with OT Administrators, Network Engineering, and Security Engineering teams to support secure and stable OT environments
* Participate in OT Office Hours and assist site teams with operational questions and issue resolution
* Support improvements, changes, and configurations to our security suite.
* Provide backup and support for other security capabilities managed by the Security Engineering Team.
* Manage and track security metrics to be included in Monthly Operating Reviews (MORs), Project Status Reviews (PSRs), and workshops.
* Up to 10% travel required based on business and project needs, including visits to manufacturing and distribution sites.


**Required Qualifications and Competencies:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 1–3 years of experience in cybersecurity, IT operations, or a related technical discipline
* Foundational understanding of networking concepts, including:IP addressing, subnets, routing, and switching fundamentals
* VLANs and network segmentation concepts (especially IT vs OT separation)
* Firewall rules and how traffic flows between systems


**Preferred Qualifications and Competencies:**


* Basic troubleshooting skills for connectivity issues (e.g., device communication failures, segmentation impacts)
* Understanding of how asset discovery tools use network traffic and integrations to identify devices
* Exposure to OT/ICS environments or manufacturing systems
* Familiarity with asset discovery, monitoring, or security tools (e.g Armis, Claroty, Dragos, and Nozomi)
* Experience supporting operational platforms or infrastructure tools
* Strong attention to detail, particularly with asset data, classification, and system accuracy
* Ability to follow defined processes and execute repeatable operational tasks with consistency
* Analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills for troubleshooting and data validation
* Effective communication and collaboration across IT, OT, and security teams
* Willingness to learn OT\-specific technologies, environments, and security practices


We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

title: Senior Associate, Cyber Security Disputes & Investigations
description:
**Description**


**Job Description: Senior Associate, Cyber Security Disputes \& Investigations**

**Overview**


Alvarez \& Marsal, a leading independent global professional services firm, specializing in providing turnaround management, performance improvement, and corporate advisory services, is seeking to expand its Disputes \& Investigations team. With more than 7,000 professionals based in 75\+ locations across 30\+ countries in North America, Europe, Asia, and Latin America, our firm excels in problem\-solving and value creation. Drawing on a strong operational heritage and hands\-on approach, our professionals work closely with organizations and stakeholders to help tackle complex business issues and maximize value.

**The Position**


As a **Senior Associate** within A\&M's Cybersecurity practice in the Disputes \& Investigations group, you will play a key role in delivering cybersecurity, privacy, risk, and AI governance engagements across diverse industries. You will work directly with clients to assess cybersecurity posture, identify risks, develop remediation roadmaps, and support implementation of security and governance frameworks.


The successful candidate will contribute to and independently execute engagements involving:

**Cybersecurity Program Maturity Assessments**

* Evaluate cybersecurity programs against industry frameworks including ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, COBIT, and other regulatory requirements.
* Assess governance structures, security operating models, policies, standards, and controls.
* Develop maturity assessments, gap analyses, and improvement roadmaps.

**IT Risk \& Security Assessments**

* Lead cybersecurity risk assessments across applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, and third\-party ecosystems.
* Perform security reviews, data classification exercises, and control effectiveness assessments.
* Identify cybersecurity risks and provide practical mitigation recommendations.

**Data Privacy \& Regulatory Compliance**

* Conduct privacy assessments against DPDPA, GDPR, ISO 27701, and other applicable regulations.
* Support development and implementation of privacy governance frameworks, policies, and operating procedures.
* Assist clients in privacy program enhancement, data lifecycle reviews, and compliance readiness initiatives.

**AI Security \& Governance**

* Assess AI systems for security, privacy, governance, and compliance risks.
* Support implementation of AI governance frameworks, risk management practices, and responsible AI controls.
* Evaluate controls related to GenAI solutions, model governance, data protection, and regulatory requirements.

**Security Awareness \& Cyber Culture**

* Design and deliver cybersecurity and privacy awareness initiatives.
* Develop training content, phishing simulation programs, and executive awareness sessions.
* Support clients in building sustainable cyber risk awareness programs.

**Cybersecurity Architecture \& Technical Reviews**

* Participate in security assessments across cloud, infrastructure, application security, identity and access management, and data security domains.
* Review technical controls and architectures against security best practices and industry standards.
* Identify gaps and recommend improvements aligned to organizational risk appetite.

**Research \& Thought Leadership**

* Monitor emerging cybersecurity threats, industry trends, AI security developments, and evolving regulatory requirements.
* Contribute to thought leadership, methodologies, accelerators, and market\-facing content.

 **Role and Responsibilities**

**Client Delivery**

* Independently execute cybersecurity, privacy, and governance engagements with minimal supervision.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, control assessments, and documentation reviews.
* Analyze findings, prioritize risks, and develop actionable recommendations.
* Prepare high\-quality client reports, presentations, and executive briefings.

**Project Management**

* Manage workstreams and deliverables while ensuring quality and adherence to timelines.
* Coordinate with client stakeholders and internal teams to drive project execution.
* Support proposal development, scoping activities, and business development efforts.

**Team Leadership \& Collaboration**

* Mentor Analysts and Associates through technical guidance and quality reviews.
* Foster collaboration across multidisciplinary teams.
* Contribute to capability building, knowledge sharing, and practice development initiatives.

**Business Development Support**

* Contribute to proposal preparation, market research, and solution development.
* Participate in client meetings, workshops, and networking activities.

**Continuous Learning**

* Stay current on cybersecurity, AI governance, privacy regulations, and industry best practices.
* Pursue relevant professional certifications and technical skill development.

 **The Requirements**

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 4\-6 years of relevant cybersecurity consulting, risk advisory, or information security experience.
* Experience delivering cybersecurity assessments, governance reviews, privacy initiatives, or compliance programs.

**Technical Competencies**

**Cybersecurity Governance \& Risk**

* Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and standards including: ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 22301, ISO 27701

**AI Security \& Governance**

* Understanding of AI governance frameworks, AI risk management principles, and responsible AI practices.
* Awareness of emerging AI security risks including model security, prompt injection, adversarial attacks, and data privacy concerns.

**Data Privacy \& Compliance**

* Experience working with DPDPA, GDPR, ISO 27701, or similar privacy regulations and standards.
* Knowledge of privacy impact assessments and data protection controls.

 **Preferred Certifications**


One or more of the following certifications are preferred: CISSP, CISA, CISM, Certified Data Privacy Professional (CIPP)

 **Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent report writing and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical and executive stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management and client\-facing skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced consulting environment.
* Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.

 **Language**

* Fluent written and verbal communication in English.
